name: council-loop
description: Research-backed looped engineering: gate -> researchers and a codebase mapper -> 7-expert council with blind votes, red team and cross-lab elders (7->5->3->1) -> verified build loop -> lessons. A shared memory of sourced facts (project files or Obsidian). One program, `council`, does the bookkeeping and must be on your PATH: a resumable run loop (next / ingest), an MCP server, and a hook that guards locked tests. Model picks per role from Artificial Analysis data; a run starts with the cheapest that works.
